verdict.rationale: BVNK exposes a dedicated Transfers v3 API for wallet-to-wallet currency conversion (replacing a legacy Quote API), plus fiat/stablecoin flows (fund in stablecoin, pay out in fiat) and partner markup-fee controls, indicating conversion is an API-first primitive. However, the pack lacks concrete documentation of quote request/response fields showing rates, fee breakdowns, or settlement-time SLAs for these conversions. missing for 10: explicit quote endpoint schema with rate/fee/settlement fields, independent confirmation of conversion accuracy or timing.
